parts.text: I don't know about specific bad days or dates from the last few months, as my notes do not record them. I do know that closures can come into force while drones of several companies are already in the air, closures are often amended during the day, and radios have patchy coverage, especially around ports, industrial sites, and in bad weather. Additionally, a closure can be sudden or planned, and batteries drain faster in cold and wind than planned.
